description: This Java source file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements the LogNode interface and provides a wrapper around Android's native Log utility. It facilitates logging with hierarchical chaining support for multiple log targets.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native Log utility to implement logging with chaining capability via LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message with specified priority, tag, and optional throwable; then forwards the log to the next node if available.
